prompt: I keep doing this manually: docker build the migrator image, minikube image load it, delete the old db-migrate job, then kubectl apply the k8s folder. Can you scriptize this whole flow?

assertions.text: Script file exists and is non-empty
Script has set -euo pipefail for error safety
Script builds gaku-migrator Docker image using correct Dockerfile
Script sources OCI env vars or sets GIT_COMMIT/BUILD_TIMESTAMP build args
Script deletes the old db-migrate job
Script has a verification/result section with [OK] or [FAIL] checks
assertions.check: grep '[OK]' or '=== Result' or 'Checklist' in script
